object_description: A successor to construct-independence v1 that retains channel separation, author separation, gold independence and permutation null, and adds a fifth pre-execution obligation for registered blocking factors so opposite-signed strata cannot cancel into a misleading aggregate.
qoi: Whether an outcome-bearing instrument has a valid aggregate estimand once all predeclared blocking factors are inspected per stratum, rather than admitting a statistic whose aggregate hides material opposite-signed effects.
scope: v2 successor to merged construct-independence v1
pre-execution declarations plus development/known-answer stratum controls
assumptions: v1 semantics remain frozen and unchanged
blocking factors must be named before outcome access
candidate code cannot read evaluator-only stratum outcome labels
a heterogeneous estimand may be valid if it is explicitly stratified rather than silently aggregated
missing registered strata or unrun stratum checks yield CANNOT_CHECK

strongest_parents.justification: Immediate predecessor. It caught one historical construct defect without false-alarming on a probative instrument but admitted #729's non-probative aggregate because it cannot see stratum cancellation.
The concrete missed class: high- and low-similarity strata have opposite effects and spread >0.10 while the aggregate sits near chance.

oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-answer fixtures inject homogeneous effects, opposite-signed cancelling effects, one-stratum-only effects, and missing-stratum cases. Exact fixture construction is the conformance oracle. V2 must admit the homogeneous stratified aggregate, reject or require stratification for cancellation, and CANNOT_CHECK missing/unrun strata.
minimal_counterexamples: two predeclared strata have equal and opposite material effects so aggregate is null
aggregate passes v1 while one stratum reverses direction
blocking factor discovered only after outcomes
candidate sees blocking-factor gold labels and learns the evaluator partition
one registered stratum is absent but aggregate is still admitted
falsifier: V2 fails if it still admits #729-style aggregate cancellation, falsely rejects a homogeneous clean instrument, or does not reduce construct-defect incidence on the next 12 closures relative to designs missing the fifth obligation.
same_system_ablation: Run the same frozen design through construct-independence v1 and v2; the only added decision-bearing input is the predeclared blocking-factor/stratum witness.
hard_gate_obligations: preserve all v1 verdicts when no blocking factor is registered
STRATUM_HOMOGENEITY declared before outcome access when blocking factors exist
opposite material signs cannot be hidden by aggregate
novelty_residual: A versioned fifth construct-independence obligation that repairs the exact v1 miss without editing v1 after seeing the outcome; it changes measurement admission only and reuses the existing RFA decision chain.
permitted_publication_claim: Only conformance/falsification until fresh forward assurance: v2 detects registered cancellation fixtures and preserves clean v1 behavior. No scientific-result truth claim.
